title: A Physicist's Visit to Exotic Spheres
summary: This thesis discusses exotic 7-spheres, i.e. manifolds that are homeomorphic but not diffeomorphic to the ordinary 7-sphere, using a set of analytical and computational tools from theoretical physics. The theory of fibre bundles and instantons, together with their relation to Yang-Mills theory, are reviewed, before presenting a generalisation of self-duality to twisted self-duality. The formalism required to derive and geometrically interpret some solutions to twisted-self-duality is relevant to the main subject of this thesis: investigating the geometry of the Gromoll-Meyer sphere.
